title: Kinship
tagline: Have unlimited children with unlimited mothers and watch them grow up
description: Requires Fertility Mode Reloaded/FM+/v3 or Beeing Female for pregnancy and birth. Kinship takes over at birth and handles naming the child, ensuring they are associated with the right mother and father, and makes them SkyrimNet-aware. Your children know who you are in the world.
author: deadohiosky
